stories.title: Emmanuel Macron est allé rencontrer Donald Trump à la Trump Tower en marge de l’Assemblée générale de l’ONU

en.title: Emmanuel Macron met Donald Trump at Trump Tower during UN General Assembly
en.summary: The French president met with Donald Trump at Trump Tower and reported having a constructive discussion regarding Ukraine and the situation in the Red Sea.

stories.title: A New York, Emmanuel Macron et Donald Trump débattent de l’Ukraine et de la flambée de l’or noir

en.title: In New York, Emmanuel Macron and Donald Trump debate Ukraine and rising oil prices
en.summary: The French president presented initiatives to the American president aimed at controlling oil barrel prices, including a proposed moratorium on Ukrainian and Russian strikes against energy infrastructure.

stories.title: Au procès de Rachida Dati pour « corruption », l’ancienne ministre face à un témoignage dévastateur

en.title: At Rachida Dati's corruption trial, former minister faces damaging testimony
en.summary: The mayor of Paris's 7th arrondissement is on trial for allegedly receiving 900,000 euros between 2010 and 2012 from the Renault-Nissan alliance when it was led by Carlos Ghosn.

stories.title: Les actionnaires de « Valeurs actuelles » se séparent du directeur du magazine, Tugdual Denis

en.title: Shareholders of "Valeurs actuelles" separate from magazine director Tugdual Denis
en.summary: The director of the conservative weekly magazine was removed by shareholders who acquired the publication, including ultraconservative billionaire Pierre-Edouard Stérin, after leading the editorial team since 2023.

stories.title: Flambée des prix des carburants : le gouvernement présentera de nouvelles aides lors d'une conférence de presse mardi à 17 heures

en.title: Fuel price surge: government will present new aid measures at press conference Tuesday at 5pm
en.summary: Government ministers met to discuss short and medium-term support measures for French citizens in response to rising fuel prices. New aid proposals will be announced at a press conference.

stories.title: "Je n'ai jamais été en situation de conflit d'intérêts" : à son procès pour corruption, l'ex-eurodéputée Rachida Dati confrontée aux soupçons de lobbying pour Renault

en.title: "I have never been in a conflict of interest situation": at her corruption trial, former MEP Rachida Dati faced with suspicions of lobbying for Renault
en.summary: Former European Parliament member Rachida Dati was questioned in Paris court about how she balanced her parliamentary duties with her work as a lawyer for French automaker Renault during a corruption trial.

stories.title: Plombé par des résultats en berne, «Valeurs actuelles» débarque son directeur de la rédaction Tugdual Denis

en.title: Weighed down by weak results, "Valeurs actuelles" removes editorial director Tugdual Denis
en.summary: The editorial director of the magazine Valeurs actuelles has stepped down after three years following declining performance, as owners seek to distance the publication from its controversial past.

stories.title: Le directeur de la rédaction de Valeurs Actuelles évincé par les actionnaires

en.title: Editor-in-chief of Valeurs Actuelles ousted by shareholders
en.summary: Tugdual Denis, who held the position for three years, left the weekly publication after shareholders voted to remove him, in a decision unrelated to the Charles Sapin matter.

stories.title: Flambée du prix des carburants : «Comment continuer de travailler sans travailler à perte ?»

en.title: Surge in fuel prices: "How can we continue working without operating at a loss?"
en.summary: Rising fuel prices are fueling public anger as several professions face financial difficulties. Nurses and home care workers, who have received limited government support, worry about declining service quality.

stories.title: Flambée des prix des carburants, cycliste mort à Paris, loi intégrale contre les violences sexuelles… L’actu de ce lundi 21 septembre

en.title: Surge in fuel prices, cyclist killed in Paris, comprehensive law against sexual violence… News from Monday, September 21
en.summary: Libération's editorial team summarizes the main news stories from Monday, September 21, covering fuel prices, a fatal cycling incident in Paris, and sexual violence legislation.

stories.title: Donald Trump va rencontrer Emmanuel Macron à New York lundi soir en marge de l'Assemblée générale des Nations unies

en.title: Donald Trump to meet Emmanuel Macron in New York on Monday evening during UN General Assembly
en.summary: The United States President and French President are scheduled to meet in New York on Monday evening during the United Nations General Assembly, according to the American President's published agenda.

stories.title: Quelles sont les pistes d'aides étudiées par le gouvernement lundi face à la flambée des prix des carburants ?

en.title: What assistance measures is the government studying Monday in response to soaring fuel prices?
en.summary: The French government is developing a stronger response to the energy crisis as fuel prices reach record levels, with several decisions pending from a Monday meeting.

stories.title: Sébastien Martin, ministre de l’Industrie : « Il s’agit de construire un marché européen qui entend se faire respecter »

en.title: Sébastien Martin, Industry Minister: "This is about building a European market that intends to be respected"
en.summary: France's Industry Minister discusses the country's approach to the Industrial Accelerator Act, a European regulation requiring local content thresholds for products sold in the continent's strategic sectors including automotive.

stories.title: Pacte Dutreil : Oxfam réclame un plafond et une baisse de l’exonération

en.title: Dutreil Pact: Oxfam calls for a ceiling and a reduction in the exemption
en.summary: Oxfam proposes capping the Dutreil Pact tax benefit at one million euros and reducing the exemption from 75% to 50%, while the government refuses to reopen the issue despite an estimated cost of 5.5 billion euros in 2024.

en.title: Indonesia receives its first aircraft carrier
en.summary: Indonesia received its first helicopter carrier last Friday, which will be used primarily for disaster response operations in the country rather than for combat purposes.

stories.title: Stellantis pourrait investir un milliard d'euros pour produire un nouvel utilitaire à Hordain

en.title: Stellantis could invest one billion euros to produce a new commercial vehicle at Hordain
en.summary: Stellantis plans to invest one billion euros to manufacture a new commercial vehicle at its Hordain facility in northern France as part of restructuring efforts led by CEO Antonio Filosa.

stories.title: Emploi des seniors : Les Increvables, « une passerelle humaine entre un recruteur et un candidat »

en.title: Senior employment: Les Increvables, "a human bridge between recruiter and candidate"
en.summary: Les Increvables, an initiative in Occitanie, works to improve employment prospects for older workers by addressing persistent barriers and misconceptions that hinder their job opportunities.
